senses.gloss: m. pl.Mantsʾfakh, a vox memorialis for the five letters (מ, נ, צ, פ, a. ך) which have separate forms at the end of words.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:13">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ</cite> <he>מ׳ הלכה וכ׳</he> the double forms for the five letters are a Mosaic tradition.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:13">Ib.</cite> <he>מהו מ׳ … מ̇ה שהתקינ̇ו לך̇ הצ̇ופ̇ים</he> what does the vox M. intimate? What the inspired seers (prophets) have instituted for thee; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:11">Gen. R. s. 1</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:11">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 104a:1">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 2b:23">Meg. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ צופים אמרום</he> M. intimates that the seers indited them; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:21">Num. R. s. 18</cite>; Tanḥ. Korah 12.
